items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...You saw that picture, didn't you, Ralph?

ctx.x: Now that's me. Oh, yeah. Don't look like it.
With a mustache. Now that's Harold. You look quite different. Well, that's Harold Deshawn right there. Yeah, he looks different too. You saw that picture, didn't you, Ralph?
Now that's a... He has a clear up net.
